name: form-builder
title: Form Builder
description: JSON-schema form for create/edit. Wrap in FormLayout and submit through formId. Field types: input, password, textarea, select, combobox, radio, choice-card, checkbox, checkbox-group, accepted, switch, slider, input-group, date, datetime, date-range, file, quantity, object, section, section-item, hidden, phone. Use ResourcePicker or renderField for HitPay catalog entities.
